Recorded claim:
about:import stores item DOM wrappers by item.id. The test ICS file had items with no ID, and review confirmed such files are plausible. The landed loop generates a UUID only when item.id is absent, before building _itemElements. Without this, multiple imported rows could share a missing object key. Current code retains the guard.

Provenance: 183350df6d2480aec49f9357c6cf3cd93de2623e85e9d54c077a4c980ec7551a. Original evidence IDs: 46264534fef41c7fa5b6db257c7a2f56033e62f2633c5f1290bc1331bae2f705, 6b91ac62803a80f8326845c6c079b3797bb0863c30b61ae7d8d43104543fbeaf, ed339f78b9d55ee252af1ee2137f6ecd33657f86441bed945ffa924bad121d7c.
This is a recorded historical interpretation, not independent source verification. Source quotes from personal imports or unconfirmed-access records remain private. Historical test results are reported outcomes; no tests were rerun for this backfill.
